_note: SYNTHETIC data only. Written and labelled BEFORE the baseline rules were written (2026-11-22). Labels by a single author (assistant) -> optimistic bias; needs independent labelling before any claim. Outcome scale: CLEAR < INVENTORY_UPDATE < NEEDS_INFO < REVIEW_REQUIRED < DPIA_LIKELY.
